title: Mirror Mirror Launches First AI Likeness Marketplace With 90% Cost Savings
summary:
Yusan Lin has developed a system for brands to book the digital identities of real creators to avoid lawsuits over unauthorized synthetic imagery. Developed as part of the a16z Speedrun program, Mirror Mirror is a marketplace where identity verified talent can grant permission for their likeness to be used in AI content through signed licenses and embedded provenance. The platform allows brands to produce campaign visuals and lookbooks up to 10x faster than traditional methods and reduce costs by as much as 90%.

Lin, an AI researcher and former model, built the infrastructure to address the lack of scalable rights management for generative AI. The service enables models and creators to earn additional income from their digital persona without the need to be physically present for production shoots.

selectedTweets.text:
AI slop isn't just tacky and uninspired. It can get you sued.

Generating fake AI faces that resemble real people, or using someone's likeness without permission, is creating new legal and reputational risks for brands.

So we built @mirrormirror_ai as part of a16z @speedrun, a marketplace where brands can digitally book real models and creators to generate AI content using their likeness, with their permission.

Brands browse and book identity-verified talent, agree on usage rights, and generate content within those terms. Every approved image comes with a signed license and embedded provenance.

We're seeing brands produce lookbooks and campaign visuals up to 10x faster, with up to 90% cost savings. Meanwhile, models and creators can earn additional income from their digital likeness without having to show up for another shoot.

Everyone is racing to make AI generation faster, cheaper, and more realistic. But there's still a huge missing piece: how do you license the rights to the people appearing in AI-generated content at scale?

That's why I'm excited about what we're building. Not just another AI generator, but the licensing and rights infrastructure for AI-generated content.

Mirror Mirror built the licensing layer that lets people grant brands permission to use their likeness for AI generation. Be a model!

Now brands can digitally license with real people instead of using generic fake AI faces or deepfakes. 

And there's no better person than @yusan_lin to build this. Her career has spanned both sides as a model and an AI researcher.
